capsule.evolution: source facts evolve in place; persistent contracts carry explicit identities

topics.description: Use statically bounded sequences, vectors, and builders so capacity is explicit.
guidance: Prefer the generic bounded builder over width-specific application helpers.

topics.description: Declare and preserve capability/effect authority at the source boundary.
guidance: An effect declaration is part of the semantic contract, not host-side metadata.

topics.description: Read, write, and publish typed artifacts through the structured artifact effects.
guidance: Keep persistent schema identities separate from implementation filenames.

topics.description: Bind source, content, revision, evidence, and artifact identities explicitly.
guidance: Prefer identity-bearing records over ambient host state.

topics.description: Select a language profile from the authoritative source-profile registry.
guidance: Use the current profile unless a compatibility boundary explicitly requires an older profile.
